whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Blue Mermaid Cafe & Kitchen,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.6★ reviews from nearly 1,000 customers in Kankarbagh, but currently, your online link redirects to Swiggy instead of a dedicated brand website.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table reservation, digital menu, aur direct WhatsApp ordering integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bluemermaid

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Blue Mermaid Cafe & Kitchen, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (Blue Mermaid Cafe & Kitchen in Kankarbagh) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We noticed you have brilliant 4.6-star ratings with over 900 reviews on Google, but your online presence was only routing through food delivery aggregators like Swiggy. Humne aapke brand ke liye ek dedicated website design ki hai jisme direct table booking, photo gallery, aur direct customer contact features hain. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
